  <div class="section-column l-block l-area relative">  <div class="l-rows l-rows--center">  <div class="l-area">  <div class="type--body-lg text--left text">
    <div class="reveal slide-in-bottom text-outer" data-zuu-reveal="children"><p>We will make your family's summer 2026 more enjoyable! Daily water sports activities for everyone, entertainment for children, attractions, a cottage a few minutes from the beach. Breakfast, dinner, and dog stay included in the package price!</p><p><strong>Package 2027 includes:</strong></p><ul><li>accommodation,</li><li>meals: breakfast and dinner buffet style with drinks. Delicious, healthy, fresh ingredients, a specially prepared children's corner - to satisfy the appetite of our younger Guests. You will also find a fit corner and vegan options on the table. Additionally, we organize live cooking - serving delicious dishes straight from the pan.</li></ul><p><strong>Fun for everyone:</strong></p><ul><li>daily 2h water sports training (for children from 8 years old) - group classes with instructors at our base SurfPoint. Lessons are for everyone, regardless of skills! Water activities: windsurfing (board with sail), surfing (basics with board on waves), skimboard, SUP safari - paddleboard trips in the Puck Bay. Classes are held according to the schedule.</li></ul><p><strong>Fun for kids and youth - we play and experience different adventures every day:</strong></p><ul><li>daily children's animations - games from morning till evening under the supervision of professional animators - a different schedule of activities every day, sports activities on the beach, creative fun</li><li>attractions for youth - bike trips, sports competitions, DIY workshops, field games</li></ul><p><strong>Fun for adults - we awaken childlike joy:</strong></p><ul><li>sports activities: yoga sessions, nordic walking, bike trips - we oxygenate, stretch and diversify time!</li><li>evenings with live music - we integrate and chill,</li><li>bonfires and attractions according to the schedule - we warm up the atmosphere,</li><li>priceless moments of peace when children play at the animations :)</li></ul><p><strong>Additionally on site:</strong></p><ul><li>Wi-Fi network in common areas</li><li>1 parking space</li><li>bonfire area, grill</li><li>playground with slides</li><li>outdoor games,</li><li>Ale Fale restaurant</li><li>coworking space with fiber internet</li></ul><p>*water activities are adjusted to current weather conditions. Water classes are for children from 8 years old.</p></div>
